# Client Brief: Atlas Dashboard

## Project Background
The client requested a modern real-time analytics platform called Atlas Dashboard.

## Key Facts
- Project: Atlas Dashboard
- Technology: React and Node.js
- Team size: 4
- Delivery: 21 days
- Budget: $4,500

## Responsibilities & Architecture
- Built real-time chart components using React and D3.
- Implemented high-throughput Node.js microservices for telemetry ingestion.
- Configured PostgreSQL with connection pooling for sub-10ms queries.
